text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Bandages, gauze wrap... Hmm, and<n>some antiseptic
for good measure, I<n>guess...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! No, that's not it. I'm just<n>looking for things
to put in my bag.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Look. Isn't it cute? It matches my<n>signature
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I thought it'd be nice to be prepared<n>in case
someone gets hurt...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, I don't know about that.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In any case, if you don't mind, would<n>you be so
kind as to help me pick out<n>a few things?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At Super Creek's request, I look for<n>some handy
items for her to carry<n>around.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Trainer. Look, it<n>all fits
perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now I'll be able to provide emergency<n>first aid if
someone gets hurt.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That goes for you too! If something<n>ever happens
to you, make sure to let<n>me know right away! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Even if it's during a race, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Just call my name, and I'll just<n>race to the
finish line faster than<n>usual! You've got nothing to
worry<n>abo—

text_block_list.name: Passionate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Your very hopes and dreams have<n>been sewn into
that signature<n>racewear of yours, haven't they?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...What's going on over there?

text_block_list.name: Passionate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You can't give up now! Tell me what<n>it is you hope
for!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...To never lose... To never lose to<n>anyone! That's
my dream!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hopes sewn into racewear...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...I just asked for my signature<n>racewear to be
made with a nice<n>design.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You said before that I'm considerate,<n>but that's not
true.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see someone getting<n>hurt, I'm
overcome by a wave of<n>sadness that makes it hard
for me to<n>breathe.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I hate feeling that way... So the reason<n>why I want
to help is really just<n>because I'm selfish.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I have no desire to be thanked, nor do<n>I want
anyone returning the favor.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
As long as people just accept me for<n>who I am,
that's honestly more than<n>enough.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I call myself selfish, yet you<n>still somehow
find a way to see me in<n>a positive light.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I believe you're the considerate onehere, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! And someone as kind as you<n>deserves to
be spoiled! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But well... I suppose you're right.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even in the harsh world of racing, I<n>want nothing
more than to be able to<n>offer comfort to people.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's the hope I've placed in my<n>signature
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek makes this statement<n>with a gleam in
her eye, revealing to<n>me a newfound resolve.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
What am I supposed to do when you<n>say
something so sweet? I... I just...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I want to spoil you like there's no<n>tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Since a coddling is in order, how<n>about you rest
your head on my lap?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The texture of my racewear feels<n>wonderful on the
skin!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Come on, now. Don't be shy! Let's<n>take a little
break on that bench over<n>there.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I want to give all the comfort in the<n>world to kind
people and hard<n>workers everywhere! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I somehow manage to put an end to<n>Super Creek's
affectionate antics<n>and avoid laying my head on her
lap.
